metadata.question: Does the snow cover in southern Siberia increase between October 14, 2018 and October 29, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Terra daily snow cover (MODIS/006/MOD10A1). If empty, fallback to MODIS Aqua (MODIS/006/MYD10A1). Two 5-day windows centered on Oct 14 and Oct 29, 2018 over a rectangle approximating southern Siberia (85E-110E, 49N-55N). 2. Masking strategy: For each image, keep only pixels with NDSI_Snow_Cover between 0 and 100 (valid). Convert to fractional snow (0-1). Composite by mean over the window. Compute valid pixel count vs total (cloud/invalid removed implicitly). 3. Valid Zero vs Null: If collections are empty → C1. If valid pixel count is 0 after masking → C2. If mean result is null/NaN → C3. Otherwise compare mean snow fractions; if Oct29 > Oct14 by >1 percentage point, answer Yes (A), else No (B). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([85.0, 49.0, 110.0, 55.0], null, false); const scale = 1000; // meters const maxPixels = 1e9; const win1 = {label: 'Oct14±2d', start: '2018-10-12', end: '2018-10-16'}; const win2 = {label: 'Oct29±2d', start: '2018-10-27', end: '2018-10-31'}; // 2. Helper functions async function getStatsForWindow(win) { const datasets = [ {id: 'MODIS/006/MOD10A1', tag: 'Terra'}, {id: 'MODIS/006/MYD10A1', tag: 'Aqua'} ]; for (let i = 0; i < datasets.length; i++) { const ds = datasets[i]; let col = ee.ImageCollection(ds.id) .filterDate(win.start, win.end) .filterBounds(region); const size = await col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { continue; // try next dataset } // Map to fractional snow [0,1] and mask invalid (retain 0..100) const processed = col.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').map(function(img) { const snow = img.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const valid = snow.gte(0).and(snow.lte(100)); const snowfrac = snow.updateMask(valid).divide(100).toFloat().rename('snowfrac'); return snowfrac.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames()); }); const mosaicMean = processed.mean(); // Pixel totals (at analysis scale) const totalDict = ee.Image(1).rename('const').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }); const totalPx = await totalDict.get('const').getInfo(); const validCountDict = mosaicMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }); const validPx = await validCountDict.get('snowfrac').getInfo(); if (validPx === null || totalPx === null) { return {status: 'C3', detail: 'Null in counts'}; } if (validPx === 0) { // Try next dataset if available if (i < datasets.length - 1) continue; return {status: 'C2', detail: 'No valid pixels'}; } const meanDict = mosaicMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }); const meanSnow = await meanDict.get('snowfrac').getInfo(); if (meanSnow === null || Number.isNaN(meanSnow)) { return {status: 'C3', detail: 'Mean is null/NaN'}; } const validPct = (validPx / totalPx) * 100.0; return { status: 'OK', dataset: ds.tag, datasetId: ds.id, images: size, totalPx: totalPx, validPx: validPx, validPct: validPct, meanSnow: meanSnow }; } // No dataset had images return {status: 'C1', detail: 'Empty collection both Terra/Aqua'}; } // 3. Run stats for both windows console.log(`Region: Rect[85E,110E,49N,55N], scale=${scale}m`); const s1 = await getStatsForWindow(win1); const s2 = await getStatsForWindow(win2); // 4. Handle failure cases function printWindow(wlabel, s) { if (s.status === 'OK') { const meanPct = (s.meanSnow * 100.0); console.log(`${wlabel} ${s.dataset}: images=${s.images}, validPx=${s.validPx}/${s.totalPx} (${s.validPct.toFixed(1)}%), meanSnow=${meanPct.toFixed(2)}%`); } else if (s.status === 'C1') { console.log(`${wlabel}: 0 images (Empty Collection)`); } else if (s.status === 'C2') { console.log(`${wlabel}: No valid pixels after masking`); } else if (s.status === 'C3') { console.log(`${wlabel}: Calculation failure (null/NaN)`); } } printWindow(win1.label, s1); printWindow(win2.label, s2); // Decide final answer // Priority of error codes if (s1.status === 'C1' || s2.status === 'C1') { console.log('C1'); return; } if (s1.status === 'C2' || s2.status === 'C2') { console.log('C2'); return; } if (s1.status === 'C3' || s2.status === 'C3') { console.log('C3'); return; } // Both OK const delta = (s2.meanSnow - s1.meanSnow) * 100.0; // percentage points console.log(`Δ snow (pp): ${delta.toFixed(2)}`); // Use 1 percentage point threshold to avoid noise if (delta > 1.0) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (err) { console.error(`Error: ${err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
